reason: A DSH web UI plugin that visualizes conversation statistics and context occupancy below the composer using existing session and token metrics.

summaries.zh: 在 DSH Web 聊天输入框下方展示完整会话统计信息和分段式上下文占用进度条。
summaries.en: Adds a full-width conversation statistics row and a segmented context-occupancy progress bar below the DSH web chat composer.

capabilities: Reads session statistics, token usage, context occupancy, and context breakdown data
Displays persistent statistics and a segmented context-occupancy progress bar in the DSH web chat UI
